name: maturin
description: Build and publish crates with pyo3, cffi and uniffi bindings as well as rust binaries as python packages

issues.title: Allow using maturin develop outside of virtualenv
Ship both python library AND binary command line tool in wheel
Support including workspace-root files in subproject sdist without duplication
Add a way to override the resultant Python package version
Defining a module `foo` results in `foo.foo` being available

discussions.title: RustScenic: a maturin-built Python package for Rust gene-network kernels
Generated stubs are not importing submodules
Adding RISE RISC-V Runners to maturin generate-ci?
How to make a Python package with multiple modules importing from Rust?
packaging a pyo3 module that requires sys.rs on the Rust side

latest_release.name: v1.16.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update version mapping for GraalPy 3.13 by @msimacek in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3297
* properly normalize / validate abiflags and include in environment signature by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3299
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3295
* Fix MinGW stable ABI library names in generated PyO3 config by @Udonburo in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3298
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3303
* fix: lossy-decode external command output in interpreter discovery by @devtechedge in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3302
* build(deps): update rustls for RUSTSEC-2026-0285 by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3308
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3309
* ci: run conda tests one at a time by @messense in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3311
* Include SOABI_PLATFORM in Python 3.15 stable ABI extension filenames by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3305
* Sort compressed tag sets by @konstin in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3315
* Update manylinux/musllinux policies to the latest main by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3322
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3316
* docs: recommend declaring the Rust MSRV by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3317
* Emit a WASI platform tag for non-bin extension wheels by @dcondrey in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3321
* Don't include the cargo target directory or cache directories in wheels built from sdists by @ngoldbaum in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3320
* fix: avoid global uv fallback in pixi environments by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3306
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3326
* Fix the cargo-deny advisories that fail Lint by @monosans in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3328
* Find versioned interpreter names like `pypy3.11` on Windows by @monosans in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3325
* Update pyo3-introspection to 0.30 by @musicinmybrain in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3329
* Ignore unreachable `zip` extract advisories in `cargo deny` by @messense in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3334
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3335
* Normalize `Provides-Extra` names from `project.optional-dependencies` by @ybai08 in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3333
* Join a multi-line description into a single-line `Summary` by @ybai08 in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3332
* Update https cert bundle for the eMudhra CA compromise by @konstin in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3337
* fix: use the toolchain pyodide-build expects by @ManonMarchand in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3338
* feat: upload emscripten wheels to pypi by @ManonMarchand in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3340
* use system ca certificates instead of ureq's WebPki when building with native-tls by @thunder-coding in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3341
* Put all `License-File` entries at the sdist root by @Fatin-Ishraq in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3331
* Pass `macosx_deployment_target` to zigbuild by @jprochazk in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3313
* Use the `pp80` ABI tag for PyPy 3.12 in the bundled sysconfig by @monosans in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3343
* fix: normalize Git Bash virtualenv paths on Windows by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3307
* feat: add configurable PGO dependency group (#3278) by @1998LJ in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3310
* fix: update rustix to 1.1.5 by @kraj in https://github.com/PyO3/maturin/pull/3344
* Release v1.16.0 by @mes
